debrief db-021
1) the actor d-e-v-i-s-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e a-m-o-n-g t-h-r-e-e b-i-d-d-e-r-s to c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e w-h-i-c-h f-i-r-m w-o-u-l-d s-u-b-m-i-t t-h-e l-o-w-e-s-t p-r-i-c-e e-a-c-h r-o-u-n-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n v-i-a e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s to a-l-i-g-n c-o-s-t e-s-t-i-m-a-t-e-s a-c-r-o-s-s the c-o-n-s-o-r-t-i-u-m and left m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-r-a-i-l-s in the in-box a-r-c-h-i-v-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s-c-r-e-e-n
3) the actor p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s with a-r-t-i-f-i-c-i-a-l m-a-r-g-i-n-s to s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e f-i-e-l-d and left d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e f-i-l-e-s on the s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-c-a-l m-a-r-k-u-p d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n
4) the actor a-g-r-e-e-d o-n h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s to the n-o-n-s-e-l-e-c-t-e-d b-i-d-d-e-r-s to r-e-t-r-o-a-c-t-i-v-e-l-y s-u-b-s-i-d-i-z-e t-h-e-i-r l-o-s-s-e-s and left b-a-n-k t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s in the i-n-v-o-i-c-e l-e-d-g-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-n-e-f-i-t-b-e-n-e-f-i-t-a-r-y a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
5) the actor d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the a-r-r-a-n-g-e-m-e-n-t in a p-r-i-v-a-t-e m-e-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e l-a-b-e-l-e-d as r-o-u-t-i-n-e b-i-d-d-i-n-g c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-i-o-n and left the d-a-t-e-s t-a-m-p-e-d p-a-g-e in the c-a-s-e f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-t-h-i-c-s-b-o-a-r-d r-e-v-i-e-w
